name: kiosk-keyboard-webc
description: Native web component variant of the kiosk keyboard, built on UI5 Web Components framework
author: Marco Beier

scripts.build: npm run build:dev && npm run build:bundle && npm run generateAPI
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:unit && npm run test:coverage:component
scripts.test:e2e: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio.conf.ts
scripts.test:e2e:open: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio.conf.ts -- --headed
scripts.test:e2e:update: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio.conf.ts -- --update-visual-baseline
scripts.test:e2e:phone-sm: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts --maxInstances 1 -- --device=phone-sm
scripts.test:e2e:phone-md: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts --maxInstances 1 -- --device=phone-md
scripts.test:e2e:phone-lg: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts --maxInstances 1 -- --device=phone-lg
scripts.test:e2e:tablet: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts --maxInstances 1 -- --device=tablet
scripts.test:e2e:phone-sm:update: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts --maxInstances 1 -- --device=phone-sm --update-visual-baseline
scripts.test:e2e:phone-md:update: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts --maxInstances 1 -- --device=phone-md --update-visual-baseline
scripts.test:e2e:phone-lg:update: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts --maxInstances 1 -- --device=phone-lg --update-visual-baseline
scripts.test:e2e:tablet:update: npm run generate && wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts --maxInstances 1 -- --device=tablet --update-visual-baseline
scripts.test:e2e:all-devices: npm run generate && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n desktop,phone-sm,phone-md,phone-lg,tablet "wdio run test/e2e/wdio.conf.ts" "wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts -- --device=phone-sm" "wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts -- --device=phone-md" "wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts -- --device=phone-lg" "wdio run test/e2e/wdio-device.conf.ts -- --device=tablet"
scripts.test:e2e:all-devices:sequential: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:phone-sm && npm run test:e2e:phone-md && npm run test:e2e:phone-lg && npm run test:e2e:tablet
scripts.test:e2e:update:all-devices: npm run test:e2e:update && npm run test:e2e:phone-sm:update && npm run test:e2e:phone-md:update && npm run test:e2e:phone-lg:update && npm run test:e2e:tablet:update
